svg.title: anishshobithps.com
svg.desc: Banner for the anishshobithps.com repository. Anish Shobith P S: the source for a portfolio, blog, and guestbook built with Next.js, React, and Postgres. A two-colour print shows the logo mascot standing on a stack of three slabs labelled Postgres, Next.js, and React, with its green plate slightly out of register.
